key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) converts policy mirror descent into a trajectory-level objective using Bellman equations, removing the need to estimate intermediate state values while preserving the same unique optimum.
engineering_relevance: This offers a simpler critic-free training recipe for RL with verifiable rewards in LLM reasoning, potentially reducing complexity and instability in practical alignment pipelines.
method: Derive a trajectory-level objective from PMD via Bellman equations for autoregressive, terminal-reward settings.
Avoid intermediate state-value estimation by optimizing directly over full trajectories.
Use a practical BPO loss with a mismatch-correction weight given by a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, where BPO is shown to be effective.
watch_item: The practical loss is an approximation of the ideal objective, so performance may depend on the quality of the smoothing and mismatch-correction design.
